# Measured shared QPE authoring context

Informed continuation after the coherent shared corpus clients. The desired
wrapper calls the existing shared estimate, initializes its precision register,
consumes that register by ordered Z measurement and returns CBits plus the
residual target. It is saved before checking and is not yet executable source.
The referenced register helpers must be ordinary definitions built from explicit
initialization, ownership conversion, measurement and classical assembly.

The current pure hierarchy accepts unitary equations. Existing Body.init0 and
Body.observeZ have node typing, but no complete instrument acceptance path.
Structural conversions are quantum-only; a rewire preserves each classical
slot's type, so it cannot silently pack m CBit slots into one CBits<m> slot.
Preserve public exhaustive Lean types and the existing IR format. Add a separate
explicit readout/codec interface with actual-step checking, not an implicit
classical type equality or a name-based QPE rule. Full preparation, pure-body
binding, reference instrument semantics and production execution remain gates.

Use small precision widths only; preserve target and zero-width frame owners,
check both result values, changed measurement targets/order, copied/dropped
classical values and explicit word-width mismatches. This is local verification
material, not a fourth external corpus or a controlled model benchmark.
